Name: (CP) 1.6 Cabins (Yellog's Wood Buildings)
Author: morphinpink
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eUPgXaI.png[/img]﻿A while ago I made an [url=http://]updated Slime Hutch[/url] for  [url=https://yellog.postype.com/post/11565362]Yellog's Wood Buildings[/url] since the 1.6 changed the size of that building, someone asked if I would make updates for the other new buildings which at the time I wasn't aware there were any. Since I found there are four new types of cabins, I figured I could try making recolors matching Yellog's mod.

I'm very new to modding in Stardew Valley, eventually if content patcher mods no longer work and I figure out how to migrate them for alternative textures I may look into it. For now CP mods should still work!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZcLAPDj.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://yellog.postype.com/post/11565362]Yellog's Wood Buildings[/url], 
[*]Download and install this Mod. Just unzip it in your Mods folder.
[/list][b]This is not a repackage of the original mod! [/b]Only my own work is included in this download, should you only install this mod the 4 new cabin types will be affected!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/XaxBwuY.png[/img]﻿
Check my other recolors matching Yellog's wood buildings aesthetic:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21413]1.6 Slime Hutch﻿[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22808]Tractor mod Garage[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22812]Cat Trees and Dog Houses[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22814]Doors Decor[/url]﻿
[/list]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2yolI37.png[/img]﻿
Of course, this is an [b]unofficial[/b] update and all credit goes to Yellog for the gorgeous building aesthetic. Hopefully Yellog will update their mods eventually. In the meantime these should blend seamlessly with the rest of your buildings.

[b]Update log 1.1.2:[/b]
[list]
[*]updated the code to 1.6 format. you should no longer be warned by smapi that this mod is not updated to 1.6
[*]added update keys to the manifest.json. now smapi will notify you of future updates.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: You must download the original mod from Yellog's site to have all the buildings, this download only includes the updated new cabins made by me.
